user_question: Calculate mean elevation for every census tract that intersects State College borough.

workflow_plan.goal: Calculate mean elevation for every census tract that intersects State College borough.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve census tract polygons
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain census tract polygon candidates covering State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve census tract polygon features covering the State College borough area. Return the candidate as a GeoPackage vector layer and preserve a stable census tract identifier field if present.

workflow_steps.title: Select census tracts intersecting State College borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Retain only census tract polygons that intersect the supplied State College borough boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform an intersection-based spatial join between the retrieved census tract polygons and the supplied State College borough boundary. Retain the census tract geometries and their stable tract identifier attributes, selecting every tract that intersects the borough boundary.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate mean elevation by intersecting census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute the mean DEM elevation for every census tract selected by the intersection step.
workflow_steps.instructions:
Compute zonal statistics using the mean statistic for each feature in intersecting_census_tracts, using input_2 as the elevation raster. Preserve the stable census tract identifier in the CSV output. Use input_1 only if runtime evidence confirms it is needed and compatible as an additional raster candidate; do not substitute it for input_2 when coverage is insufficient.
Recovery constraint: Reject the unsuitable candidate and retrieve another candidate satisfying the observed requirement.

requirements.scope: Retrieved census tract candidates must cover the State College borough area sufficiently to identify every census tract intersecting the borough.

agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic raster reprojection, resampling, clipping, raster calculation, and zonal statistics. Consumes GeoTIFF rasters and GeoPackage polygon zones.
